multipatient registry from profile.#comment: One intake adapter for every physical slot. Preserve original pathology data; no P4/P5 copies.

multipatient registry plan path.#comment: Dijkstra on explicitly authored walkable edges. Proximity never creates an edge. Callers must include verified approach and stretcher-return nodes, not just a nearest waypoint.

multipatient registry compatibility chec.#comment: Non-destructive HPG smoke test: only scratch params, no patients/crew/mission flags changed.

multipatient registry SDK probe.#comment: Fresh allocations on EVERY call; do not mutate literal arrays held in a command definition.

set_dispatch.text: Preparation only: the five-patient scene and transport conversion is not activated in this build.
The check result is saved automatically in the patient_registry snapshot field.

multipatient registry capture.#comment: The main Debug snapshot is saved BEFORE this optional extension. Never let registry serialization block the existing snapshot.

multipatient registry submit.#comment: Workers enqueue once and wait. Only the service executes mutations, so commands from different HPG threads cannot interleave a reservation transaction.

multipatient registry service.#comment: Invoke once from the lifecycle worker, never from a crew, renderer, or snapshot. All registry writes occur here; callers use submit. No nested service thread.

multipatient registry reserve.#comment: No waits, threads, or object operations in this transaction. Publish ownership before movement. Requested slot 0 means automatic projected-priority selection.

multipatient registry transition.#comment: A stale worker cannot commit after timeout/reassignment: every update carries the reservation generation.

multipatient registry release.#comment: Only an unstarted reservation is automatically reusable. Loading failures require physical recovery first, not a second crew claiming the same stretcher.
